Variants.Content: Protection, kin recognition and credible rewards sustain leadership. Roman cooperation must offer followers returns rather than an outside title alone.
Protection, kin recognition and rewards support Zokomos. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Roman titles cannot replace followers’ actual returns.
Roman titles cannot replace followers’ actual returns. Nominal rights require local execution, with consent and supply both shaping authority. Protection, kin recognition and rewards support Zokomos.
Protection, kin recognition and rewards support Zokomos. Households judge rule through protected families, land and responses to appeals. Roman titles cannot replace followers’ actual returns.

Roman titles cannot replace followers’ actual returns. Arbitration and delivered promises support trading credit; distant prestige still needs local response. Protection, kin recognition and rewards support Zokomos.
